# [TASK] E2E tests: Playwright driving the Filmpire React app against the local stack

## Task

Add a Playwright end-to-end test suite that drives the real LMDB React app (`frontend/lmdb`) against the local backend stack, exercising the TMDB-facade user journeys at the browser level. Complements the existing API-level Postman/newman smoke test (`.github/workflows/e2e-smoke.yml`, #47) rather than replacing it.

## Scope

- Playwright project lives in this repo (`e2e/`), with a documented way to bring up backend + React app before the suite runs.
- Auth flow (real TMDB redirect) can't run headless — skipped/mocked here; already covered at the API level by #33 (closed).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Playwright project set up under `e2e/` with a documented way to bring up the stack (backend + React app) before running it (`e2e/README.md`, `e2e/playwright.config.js`)
- [x] Test scenarios cover: home lists, genre filter, search, movie details (videos + credits), actor page, pagination (`e2e/tests/user-journeys.spec.js`)
- [x] Cache-hit scenario asserts (via the backend metrics endpoint) that repeat navigation causes no new TMDB egress (`e2e/tests/cache-metrics.spec.js`)
- [x] Auth-flow scenario explicitly skipped or mocked, with a comment pointing to #33's API-level coverage (`e2e/tests/auth-flow.spec.js`)
- [x] CI workflow `.github/workflows/e2e-playwright.yml` triggers the suite on a nightly schedule and `workflow_dispatch`, separate from per-push CI. It has not completed successfully: the job runs `npm test` without starting the backend or the frontend dev server first, so all 32 runs to date have failed at that step (#320)

## Estimate

**Hours:** 10

## Notes
Related: #30 and #19 (closed). Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §10.4. #320 tracks making the CI workflow start the stack before running the suite.
